content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For Junior Research Fellow: M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc (Engg.) or equivalent post graduate degree in First Class with an aggregate minimum of 60% or CGPA/CPI grading of 6.5 on a 10 point scale. CSIR – UGC – NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE qualified only.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum age for Junior Research Fellow: 28 years. Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, applicable relaxations for Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Widows, Divorced Women and Women judicially separated from their husbands and who are not remarried as per GoI orders.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: For Junior Research Fellow: Rs. 37,000/- per month plus campus accommodation or HRA@20%

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIITDM Jabalpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIITDM Jabalpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIITDM Jabalpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Junior Research Fellow posts at IIITDM Jabalpur is 17 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow posts in IIITDM Jabalpur?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Junior Research Fellow position in the IIITDM Jabalpur Recruitment 2026. This is a great opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIITDM Jabalpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: According to the official notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Junior Research Fellow posts. Candidates can apply without any cost.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Junior Research Fellow posts at IIITDM Jabalpur?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST, OBC, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Widows, and Divorced Women as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for a Junior Research Fellow at IIITDM Jabalpur?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month. Additionally, campus accommodation or HRA@20% will be provided, making it an attractive package.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc (Engg.) or equivalent post-graduate degree in First Class with at least 60% marks or CGPA 6.5/10. CSIR-UGC-NET or GATE qualification is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIITDM Jabalpur Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIITDM Jabalpur primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow position is Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. IIITDM Jabalpur is located at Pincode 482005, offering a conducive research environment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to apply for IIITDM Jabalpur Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for the IIITDM Jabalpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment through the official website, which is https://www.iiitdmj.ac.in. The application link will be active until the last date.

faq.answer: The interview for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIITDM Jabalpur is scheduled for 28 August 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview details in due course.
